_what: Which LEGACY SPELLING families the owner has authorised folding onto their catalogue code. A value in this file is still only folded when the phrase mapper decodes it to exactly that one code — the list narrows what may be touched, it never widens what a rule decides.
_why_a_file: The measurement found 14 such groups over 1,491 document lines. The owner authorised ONE of them. An authorisation that lives in a transcript is an authorisation the next session invents the scope of, so it lives here with the words he used.
_the_harm_it_bounds: specials composes computeVariantKey, so folding a spelling onto its code MERGES two stock buckets. That is a stock move, not a tidy-up, and it is refused by the same guard every other spec tool uses (scripts/lib/spec-chain-guard.mjs, docs/bugs/0722 and 0844).
_measured: Production run 34728515268, 2026-09-13, company 1: 200 legacy values on 1,491 document lines; 128 of them group onto 14 catalogue codes; 72 (272 lines) the rules can place on no option and which stay as free text.
